response.sql: WITH linked_fees AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL AND o.orderbase IS NOT NULL), channel_rates AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM linked_fees GROUP BY orderbase), overall_rate AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM linked_fees) SELECT AVG(c.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_channel_fee_rate, AVG(c.avg_fee_rate - r.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_amount_above_average FROM channel_rates AS c CROSS JOIN overall_rate AS r WHERE c.avg_fee_rate > r.avg_fee_rate
